core: Promotion of macropinocytosis and membrane ruffling
name: Promotion of macropinocytosis, ruffling and early endosome trafficking
rationale: All members positively regulate fluid-phase uptake (macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, ruffles, podosomes) and onward early-endosome trafficking; unlike the confusables it lacks Rho GTPase cycles, clathrin/caveolin endocytosis and negative actin regulators.

qualifier: protein and RNA import, cristae organization
name: Mitochondrial protein and RNA import, processing and cristae organization
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein and RNA/tRNA import, presequence processing and degradation, calcium import, fusion and cristae/outer membrane organization; distinct from respiratory-complex assembly (C1), mitophagy/fission dynamics (C2, C3) and inner-membrane insertion (C4).

qualifier: palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing, RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and lipidation, Hedgehog autoproteolysis and palmitoylation, and RAS C-terminal processing; confusables instead carry GPI anchoring, Wnt/PORCN acylation and geranylgeranylation.

core: Cellular response to nitrosative and peroxide stress
name: Cellular response to nitrosative stress and peroxides
rationale: All members are responses to nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen species or hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides, without the apoptosis-regulation, ROS detoxification or hypoxia/ischemia content of the confusables.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular help
name: B cell activation, germinal center and memory responses
rationale: Members cover BCR-driven B cell proliferation, germinal center and B-1 differentiation, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation and memory responses, whereas confusables emphasise B cell development and differentiation.

core: Glutamate and GABA plasma membrane reuptake
name: Excitatory amino acid and GABA reuptake, GABA metabolism
rationale: Members span glutamate/aspartate and GABA plasma-membrane uptake (including SLC1A transporter disorders) plus GABA synthesis and degradation, unlike the glycinergic, vesicular-loading and cholinergic confusables.

qualifier: brainstem/pons maturation, locomotor and reflex behaviors
name: Brainstem and hindbrain maturation with locomotor and reflex behavior
rationale: Members combine brainstem, pons and hindbrain development with locomotion, righting, suckling and respiratory control; confusables instead stress hindbrain cell migration or cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia development.

name: CDX- and HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte differentiation
rationale: Two of three members are CDX/HNF4-driven differentiated enterocyte programmes (leukocyte migration is an outlier), distinguishing it from crypt stem/epithelial development (C1, C4) and bile-acid handling (C2, C3).

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: Every member is resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants to a specific TKI, whereas confusables describe constitutive signaling by oncogenic RTK variants without drug resistance.

qualifier: of PS, PG, PE and PC
name: Phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling of PS, PG, PE, PC
rationale: Members are acyl-chain remodeling of phosphatidylserine, -glycerol, -ethanolamine and -choline; confusables add de novo synthesis, lysophospholipid hydrolysis, DAG/TAG or PI remodeling instead.

name: Pain, itch and thermal sensation with fever generation
rationale: Members are detection and perception of painful mechanical/thermal stimuli, thermoception, itch and fever; the closest confusable (C3) adds K2P channels but lacks itch and fever, others are taste, smell or touch.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast development and intramembranous bone morphogenesis
rationale: Members centre on RUNX2-regulated osteoblast development, direct ossification, trabecular and cranial suture formation (with tendon/cartilage morphogenesis); confusables cover chondrocyte/endochondral ossification or generic osteoblast proliferation control.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
name: KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR oncogenic mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutants/fusions and their TKI binding or resistance, whereas confusables centre on FLT3 mutants, EPO/TPO signaling and PDGFR fusions.

name: Cadherin-based adherens junction assembly, turnover and EMT
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion, adherens junction assembly, CDH1/CDH11 regulation and degradation and EMT, distinct from tight junctions (C1) and the desmosome/polarity content of C2-C4.

name: Amelogenesis, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption
rationale: Members are enamel mineralization (including SLC24A4 amelogenesis imperfecta), dentin formation, tooth eruption and secretory protein phosphorylation, unlike the bone mineralization, cementum/odontoblast and phosphate/vitamin D confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layers and motor coordination
name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glia layer formation with proprioception, motor learning and voluntary locomotion, unlike forebrain (C1), vocal behavior (C2) or brainstem/pons maturation (C3, C4).

name: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and DPM-CDG
rationale: Members are GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and DPM1-3 deficiencies; confusables instead hold other CDGs (DOLK, PMM2, MPI, PGM1).

qualifier: with congenital glycosylation and storage disorders
name: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis, degradation and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members span N-/O-glycan, GAG, glycosphingolipid and GPI synthesis and lysosomal degradation with their CDG and mucopolysaccharidosis defects, distinct from Golgi vesicle traffic (C1, C3), ECM proteoglycans (C2) and central carbohydrate metabolism (C4).

name: Hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and peptidyl hydroxylation modifications
rationale: Members are rare residue modifications of translation factors and tRNA (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine) plus peptidyl hydroxylation, unlike polyamine metabolism, selenocysteine, aminoacylation or methylation confusables.

name: Spindle orientation in forebrain neural progenitor division
rationale: Members pair astral microtubule and spindle positioning with forebrain neuroblast division and stem cell maintenance; C1 lacks the neural progenitor part, C3/C4 lack the spindle machinery.

name: Olfaction and sour taste perception
rationale: Members are smell and sour-taste perception; confusables carry olfactory receptor expression, acid-sensing channels or sweet/bitter/umami/salty taste instead.

name: Neutral amino acid plasma membrane transport
rationale: All members are transmembrane transport of neutral amino acids (glutamine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, alanine), unlike peptide, cationic amino acid or organic ion transport confusables.

name: Glycine, threonine and proline metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members cover glycine, threonine, proline and glyoxylate metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinct from alanine (C1), glutamate/aspartate (C2) and aromatic/sulfur amino acid (C3) confusables.

qualifier: translation, mitoribosome assembly and RNA modification
name: Mitochondrial translation, mitoribosome assembly and mt-RNA modification
rationale: Members are mitochondrial translation steps, mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing; confusables emphasise mtRNA decay, mtDNA replication or pseudouridylation.

core: Endocytic uptake and early endosome sorting
name: Clathrin- and caveolin-mediated endocytosis and early endosome sorting
rationale: Members regulate clathrin cargo recognition, caveolin/raft endocytosis, pinocytosis, transcytosis and early-endosome routing, unlike macropinocytosis/ruffling (C4), recycling (C2) or receptor internalization/degradation (C3).
